note: The ten practitioner lines and what each stocks, transcribed from Nourhan Shams's own compiled catalogue. Collectively the ten span more than 3,000 individual SKUs; what is listed here is the clinically used core of each, by physiological system. The caution on each category was written for this tool.

brands.name: Thorne
brands.positioning: Single-entity vitamins and minerals, botanical phytosomes, and condition-specific targeted blends.

brands.name: Pure Encapsulations
brands.positioning: Hypoallergenic single nutrients and focused complexes, free from lubricants, binders and the top allergens.

brands.name: Ortho Molecular
brands.positioning: Therapeutic-dose combination formulas built around trademarked, clinically trialled ingredients.

brands.name: Metagenics
brands.positioning: Proprietary lifestyle-therapy formulas, medical foods, and targeted lipid mediators.

brands.name: Integrative Therapeutics
brands.positioning: Pharmaceutical-grade botanical extracts, licensed European phytomedicines, and digestive enzymes.

brands.name: Designs for Health
brands.positioning: Branded raw materials in high-dose therapeutic powders and specialised softgel delivery formats.

brands.name: Xymogen
brands.positioning: Closed-distribution clinical formulas built around patented delivery platforms such as MaxSimil enzymatic pre-digestion.

brands.name: Klaire Labs
brands.positioning: Hypoallergenic probiotic compounding, and targeted systemic and biofilm enzymes.

brands.name: Seeking Health
brands.positioning: Product lines split by methylation tolerance — parallel methylated and methyl-free options — and by the histamine pathways.

brands.name: Gaia Herbs
brands.positioning: Certified organic whole-plant fluid extracts and phyto-caps, with lot-level phytochemical assay verification.

groups.products: Basic B Complex, Stress B-Complex, Methyl-Guard, Methyl-Guard Plus, B-Complex #12, 5-MTHF (1 mg and 5 mg), Hydroxo B12
groups.caution: Pyridoxine above roughly 100 mg daily, taken chronically, causes a sensory neuropathy that is only partly reversible — total the B6 across every product the patient takes. High-dose methylfolate provokes anxiety, irritability and insomnia in a subset; start low. Never correct folate without knowing B12 status, or the neuropathy progresses while the anaemia resolves.

groups.products: Magnesium Bisglycinate (powder and capsules), Magnesium CitraMate, Cal-Mag Citrate, Iron Bisglycinate, Ferrasorb (iron with active B-vitamin cofactors), Zinc Picolinate (15 mg and 30 mg), Pic-Mins, Catalyte
groups.caution: Iron is the leading cause of fatal poisoning in small children — dispense with that warning every time. Separate iron from zinc, calcium, levothyroxine and quinolones by two to four hours. Zinc above 40 mg daily long-term induces copper deficiency; pair or monitor.

groups.products: Berberine-500, Berberine Dual Action, Choleast-900 (red yeast rice), CoQ10, ResveraCel (nicotinamide riboside with resveratrol and quercetin), Super EPA, Omega-3 with CoQ10
groups.caution: Choleast is red yeast rice, and its monacolin K is chemically lovastatin: the same myopathy, rhabdomyolysis and hepatotoxicity risk, never alongside a statin, and not in pregnancy. Berberine inhibits CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein and lowers blood glucose — check the medication list, and do not use it in pregnancy or in neonates.

groups.products: Bio-Gest (hydrochloric acid, pepsin, ox bile, pancreatin), Betaine HCL & Pepsin, Bacillus Coagulans, FloraMend Prime Probiotic, MediClear Plus / MediClear SGS (rice and pea detox powders), Siliphos (milk thistle phytosome), GI-Encap, Pepti-Guard
groups.caution: Betaine HCl and pepsin are contraindicated in active ulcer disease and alongside NSAIDs, corticosteroids or acid suppression. Ox bile is contraindicated in complete biliary obstruction. The cleanse powders are meal replacements — count their protein and micronutrients against everything else, and do not run one in pregnancy or in an underweight patient.

groups.products: Cortrex (adrenal cortex extract), Phytogen, Thyrocsin, Quercetin Phytosome, Zinc Carnosine, Vitamin D/K2 Liquid Drops, Vitamin D-5,000
groups.caution: Cortrex is a bovine glandular: the corticosteroid content of adrenal cortex extracts is not standardised, and it is not a treatment for, or a substitute for investigating, suspected adrenal insufficiency. Thyrocsin carries iodine and tyrosine — iodine can precipitate or worsen dysfunction in autoimmune thyroid disease. Vitamin K2 antagonises warfarin.

groups.products: O.N.E. Multivitamin, PureGenomics Multivitamin (tailored for common SNPs), Nutrient 950 (with iron, without iron, or without copper and iron), Athletic Nutrients, Prenatal Nutrients
groups.caution: Preformed retinol above 3,000 µg (10,000 IU) daily is teratogenic — total the vitamin A across the multivitamin, any cod liver oil and any A drops before it goes near a pregnancy. Choose the iron-free version by default in men and postmenopausal women, and always in haemochromatosis.

groups.products: Magnesium (glycinate, citrate, malate), Zinc (glycinate, citrate, picolinate), Iron-C, Potassium Magnesium Citrate, Copper Glycinate, MicroMinerals (trace mineral complex)
groups.caution: Magnesium accumulates in renal impairment. Potassium supplements are hazardous alongside an ACE inhibitor, an ARB or a potassium-sparing diuretic. Zinc long-term needs copper cover; iron away from zinc, calcium, levothyroxine and quinolones.

groups.products: Digestive Enzymes Ultra (with and without betaine HCl), DGL Plus (deglycyrrhizinated liquorice complex), MicroDefense with Oregano, Probiotic 50B, Probiotic G.I., Poly-Prebiotic powder, L-Glutamine
groups.caution: Live probiotics are contraindicated in the immunocompromised, in anyone with a central venous catheter, and in acute pancreatitis. Betaine HCl not with an active ulcer or on acid suppression. Glutamine needs care in hepatic encephalopathy and in a seizure history.

groups.products: PureGG, SeroPlus (serotonin pathway support), NeuroPure, Curcumin 500 with Bioperine, Lithium Orotate (5 mg), DHEA (10 mg, 25 mg), Melatonin (0.5 mg, 3 mg, 20 mg), Daily Stress Formula
groups.caution: Lithium orotate is lithium: low dose, but not benign in renal impairment or alongside an ACE inhibitor, thiazide or NSAID, and never with prescribed lithium carbonate. Melatonin 20 mg is twenty to sixty times the physiological dose — start at 0.3–1 mg. Serotonin-pathway products with an SSRI, SNRI, MAOI or triptan risk serotonin syndrome. DHEA is a hormone, not a nutrient. Piperine in the curcumin raises the absorption of many drugs.

groups.products: NAC (600 mg and 900 mg), Liposomal Glutathione, Reduced Glutathione, Ascorbic Acid, Buffered Ascorbate, Quercetin, Liver-G.I. Detox, Innate Immune Support
groups.caution: NAC causes nausea and, rarely, bronchospasm, and may blunt the effect of nitroglycerin. High-dose vitamin C adds an oxalate load — avoid in stone-formers and in renal impairment — and gives false readings on some glucometers. Quercetin inhibits CYP3A4.

groups.products: SBI Protect (powder and capsules; serum-derived bovine immunoglobulins), Ortho Biotic, Ortho Spore IG, Mucosagen, Ortho Digestzyme, Super C-Biotic, DiaResQ
groups.caution: SBI Protect is bovine serum-derived — say so before dispensing, both for bovine allergy and for patients whose diet or religion makes it unacceptable. Spore-forming probiotics carry the same immunocompromised and central-line contraindications as any live organism.

groups.products: CM Core (berberine with alpha-lipoic acid), Berberine, Bergamot BPF, Vascanox HP (nitric oxide support), Ortho Mega (820 mg EPA/DHA), CoQ-10, Alpha Lipoic Acid
groups.caution: Berberine, bergamot and alpha-lipoic acid each lower blood glucose; stacked on metformin or a sulfonylurea they cause hypoglycaemia. Berberine inhibits CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, is contraindicated in pregnancy, and displaces bilirubin — never in neonates.

groups.products: AdreneVive, NuAdapt, Cateacalm, Cerenity, Cerenity PM, CopaCalm, DHEA
groups.caution: The Cerenity and CopaCalm formulas carry 5-HTP and GABA precursors: do not combine them with an SSRI, SNRI, MAOI, triptan or linezolid. DHEA is a hormone — measure DHEA-S first, monitor after, and check your prescribing scope.

groups.products: HepatoCORE, PhytoCore, Core Level Hepatic, NAC, Alpha-Base Multivitamin (with or without iron)
groups.caution: Take the iron-free multivitamin as the default: iron in haemochromatosis, or on an unexplained raised ferritin, does real harm. Formulas that drive hepatic clearance also change the clearance of the patient's medicines, oral contraception included.

groups.products: Viracid, Natural D-Hist (quercetin, stinging nettles, bromelain, NAC), D-Hist Jr., Reacted Magnesium (bisglycinate and malate), Reacted Zinc, Reacted Iron, K-Force (D3/K2), CollaGEN, Traumeric
groups.caution: Viracid contains echinacea and andrographis; andrographis is contraindicated in pregnancy. Bromelain in the D-Hist formulas has antiplatelet activity — stop before surgery and take care with an anticoagulant. K-Force's vitamin K2 antagonises warfarin.

groups.products: SPM Active (standardised 17-HDHA and 18-HEPE specialised pro-resolving mediators), OmegaGenics EPA-DHA 720, EPA-DHA 1000, Liquid 2400, Mega 10
groups.caution: Multi-gram EPA/DHA raises bleeding time and, at 4 g daily and above, has been associated with atrial fibrillation in cardiovascular outcome trials. Stop before surgery, and count the dose rather than the capsule.

groups.products: UltraFlora Balance, UltraFlora Spectrum, UltraFlora Immune Defense, UltraFlora Integrity (gut lining), UltraFlora Women's
groups.caution: The standard live-organism contraindications: immunocompromise, a central venous catheter, acute pancreatitis. Strain, not genus, is what the evidence attaches to.

groups.products: UltraClear Plus, UltraClear RENEW (metabolic detox powder), UltraInflamX Plus 360° (gut anti-inflammatory meal replacement), CandiBactin-AR, CandiBactin-BR, SpectraZyme Complete, SpectraZyme Metagest (betaine HCl with pepsin)
groups.caution: CandiBactin-AR is thyme and oregano essential oil and -BR is berberine with coptis and Chinese goldthread: neither in pregnancy, and berberine brings its CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein interactions. Metagest is betaine HCl — not with an active ulcer or on acid suppression. Medical foods are meal replacements; total their nutrients against the rest of the plan.

groups.products: Ultra Glucose Control, ChondroCare, Insinase, Meta Lipoate 300 and 600, CoQ-Clear
groups.caution: Ultra Glucose Control, Insinase and lipoate all act on glycaemia — layering them on a diabetic regimen invites hypoglycaemia. Recheck the medication rather than adding to it.

groups.products: PhytoMulti (phytonutrient multivitamin), Mag Glycinate, Cal Apatite Bone Builder (microcrystalline hydroxyapatite concentrate), NuSera, Adreset, Serenagen, ExeQvite
groups.caution: Adreset and Serenagen are adaptogenic and can be stimulating — caution in bipolar disorder and late in the day. PhytoMulti comes with and without iron; check which one you handed over. Bone Builder is a bovine bone-derived hydroxyapatite.

groups.products: Lavela WS 1265 (clinically studied Lavandula angustifolia essential oil), Theracurmin HP (high-bioavailability curcumin), Berberine Complex, Cortisol Manager (ashwagandha and L-theanine), HPA Adapt
groups.caution: Cortisol Manager is sedating: dose at night and warn about driving. Ashwagandha raises thyroid hormones — avoid in hyperthyroidism — and is a nightshade. Concentrated curcumin carries an emerging idiosyncratic hepatotoxicity signal; stop it for any transaminase rise.

groups.products: Similase (plant-derived digestive enzymes), Similase BV, Similase Sensitive Stomach, Rhizinate (chewable DGL liquorice), Glutashield, Para-Gard (broad-spectrum intestinal support), Berberol
groups.caution: Rhizinate is deglycyrrhizinated, which is the point — whole liquorice raises blood pressure and lowers potassium, so check that any liquorice product in the plan really is DGL. Para-Gard and Berberol are botanical antimicrobials: not in pregnancy.

groups.products: ViraCon, Sambucus Nigra Zinc Lozenges, Esberitox (chewable echinacea blend), Zinc Chewables
groups.caution: Echinacea in Asteraceae allergy, and the traditional caution in progressive systemic disease. Zinc lozenges beyond a week or two depress copper and distort taste and smell. Elderberry preparations only — raw berries, leaves and bark are cyanogenic.

groups.products: Active B-Complex, Neurologix, Kre-Alkalyn (buffered creatine), Pro-Som, K-Pax Energy
groups.caution: Pro-Som is sedating and K-Pax is stimulating; they are not interchangeable “energy” products. Creatine requires adequate hydration and is questionable in renal impairment. Total the B6 across every B-complex in the plan.

groups.products: GI-Revive (powder and capsules; zinc carnosine, aloe, mucilage, glutamine), ProbioMed 50 and 100, Digestzymes, GastroMend-HP, Tri-Butyrin Supreme, PaleoGreens
groups.caution: Glutamine needs care in hepatic encephalopathy and in a seizure history, and is debated in active malignancy. Aloe inner leaf is fine; whole-leaf preparations are laxative and not for prolonged use. ProbioMed carries the live-organism contraindications.

groups.products: PaleoCleanse Plus, VegeCleanse Plus, Amino-D-Tox, LV-GB Complex (liver and gallbladder lipotropic support), Calcium D-Glucarate
groups.caution: The cleanse powders are meal replacements — count their protein and micronutrients, and do not run one in pregnancy or in an underweight patient. LV-GB contains bile salts: contraindicated in complete biliary obstruction. Calcium D-glucarate inhibits beta-glucuronidase and so alters the recycling of any glucuronidated drug, oral contraceptives included.

groups.products: Annatto-E 150 and 300 (pure tocotrienol vitamin E), Annatto-GG, Sensitol (myo-inositol and D-chiro-inositol 40:1), Berb-Evail, Curcum-Evail, Neuromag (magnesium L-threonate), Magnesium Malate
groups.caution: Tocotrienols at higher doses affect bleeding time — stop before surgery, care with an anticoagulant. Magnesium L-threonate is still magnesium: total the elemental dose across every product. The Evail softgels raise absorption, so their milligram figures do not compare with a plain powder.

groups.products: CatechoCalm, NeuroCalm, Mood Stasis, Insomnitol (capsules and chewables), Adrenal Complex, Dopaboost, 5-HTP Supreme
groups.caution: 5-HTP Supreme, NeuroCalm, Mood Stasis and Dopaboost act on monoamines — never alongside an SSRI, SNRI, MAOI, triptan or linezolid without checking, and 5-HTP is contraindicated with carbidopa. Insomnitol is sedating.

groups.products: MonoPure 1300 EC and 650 EC (MaxSimil pre-digested monoglyceride fish oil), CurcuPlex-95, CoQmax Omega
groups.caution: Pre-digested lipids absorb far better, so the milligram figure is not comparable with a standard fish oil — read the delivered EPA/DHA, and carry the bleeding-time and atrial-fibrillation cautions across at the higher exposures.

groups.products: OptiCleanse GHI (gastrointestinal and hepatic functional food powder), MedCaps DPO (dual-phase liver support), ColonX, IgG 2000 C-DF (dairy-free immunoglobulins)
groups.caution: Driving Phase I and Phase II clearance changes the clearance of everything the patient takes, contraception and narrow-therapeutic-index drugs included — review the medication list first. ColonX contains stimulant laxative herbs: short courses only, and not in bowel obstruction, pregnancy or inflammatory bowel disease.

groups.products: ProbioMax Daily DF, ProbioMax Lean, ProbioMax Complete DF, ProbioMax Plus DF (with prebiotic arabinogalactan)
groups.caution: The standard live-organism contraindications. Prebiotic arabinogalactan can worsen bloating in small-intestinal bacterial overgrowth — the population most likely to be handed it.

groups.products: Methyl Protect, AngiNOX (arginine and citrulline nitric oxide precursors), Berb-Active, ActivNutrients (iron-free and performance lines)
groups.caution: Methyl Protect is high-dose methylation support: know B12 status before giving folate, and start low in anyone who reacts to methyl donors. Arginine is avoided after recent myocardial infarction, and can provoke recurrence in herpes simplex. Berberine brings its CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein interactions.

groups.products: Immunitone Plus, Nrf2 Activator, RelaxMax (myo-inositol, GABA and L-theanine), Memorall, AdrenaMax
groups.caution: Immunitone contains echinacea and andrographis — not in pregnancy. Oral GABA's central effect is contested; RelaxMax is best judged on the inositol and theanine. AdrenaMax is adaptogenic and can be stimulating.

groups.products: Ther-Biotic Complete (12-strain, 25 billion CFU hypoallergenic base), Ther-Biotic Synbiotic, Ther-Biotic Women's, Ther-Biotic Children's, Target b2, Saccharomyces boulardii
groups.caution: Live organisms: contraindicated in the immunocompromised, with a central venous catheter, and in acute pancreatitis. S. boulardii is a live yeast with case reports of fungaemia in critically ill patients — never open the capsule on such a ward.

groups.products: Interfase, Interfase Plus (enzymes with disodium EDTA to destabilise bacterial and yeast biofilm), Vital-Zymes Complete (broad-spectrum non-animal digestive enzymes), Serratia Peptidase
groups.caution: Interfase Plus contains disodium EDTA, which chelates minerals — separate it from mineral supplements and do not run it long-term without checking status. Serrapeptase has antiplatelet activity: stop before surgery, care with an anticoagulant.

groups.products: Micellized Vitamin A Liquid, Vitamin D3 Drops, Methylfolate, E-Mussio, Seleno-Met (L-selenomethionine)
groups.caution: Micellized vitamin A is preformed retinol and drops are easy to over-give — teratogenic above 3,000 µg (10,000 IU) daily. Selenium has a narrow window: above about 400 µg daily is toxic, with hair and nail loss and a garlic breath odour.

groups.products: Optimal Prenatal, Optimal Multivitamin, B-Complex Plus, HomocysteX Plus, Active B12 with L-5-MTHF
groups.caution: Start low. High-dose methylfolate and methylcobalamin provoke anxiety, irritability and insomnia in a subset of patients. Never correct folate without knowing B12 status. Count the prenatal's vitamin A and iron against everything else in the plan.

groups.products: Optimal Prenatal MF, Optimal Multivitamin MF, B-Complex MF (folinic acid with hydroxocobalamin and adenosylcobalamin), Hydroxo B12 with Folinic Acid, Adeno B12
groups.caution: The MF line exists because some patients cannot tolerate methyl donors — it is an alternative, not an inferior version. Folinic acid still masks a B12 deficiency, so B12 status is checked either way.

groups.products: HistaminX (herbal and nutrient mast-cell support), Histamine Digest (exogenous diamine oxidase), Histamine Nutrients
groups.caution: Histamine Digest is diamine oxidase from porcine kidney — tell patients for whom that matters. It acts only on histamine in food, not on endogenous mast-cell release, so it does nothing for a patient whose problem is degranulation.

groups.products: Optimal Liposomal Glutathione, Optimal Glutathione Plus, Liver Nutrients, Ox Bile
groups.caution: Ox bile is contraindicated in complete biliary obstruction and can loosen the stool sharply. Glutathione products are sulphurous and commonly cause nausea at higher doses.

groups.products: Professional HPA Axis, Adrenal Health Daily Support, Adrenal Health Jumpstart, Holy Basil Leaf, Rhodiola Rosea
groups.caution: Rhodiola and holy basil are stimulating — caution in bipolar disorder, and not late in the day. Holy basil has antiplatelet activity and may lower blood glucose.

groups.products: Oil of Oregano Liquid Phyto-Caps, Quick Defense (echinacea, andrographis, elderberry), Echinacea Supreme, Black Elderberry Extra Strength
groups.caution: Oregano oil is mucosally irritant and not for long courses or for pregnancy. Andrographis in Quick Defense is contraindicated in pregnancy. Elderberry as a prepared extract only — raw berries, leaves and bark are cyanogenic.

groups.products: Liver Cleanse, Milk Thistle Seed extract, Turmeric Supreme Extra Strength, Turmeric Supreme Pain P.M.
groups.caution: Concentrated turmeric and curcumin carry an emerging idiosyncratic hepatotoxicity signal, particularly with piperine — stop for any transaminase rise, and note the irony of that in a liver protocol. Pain P.M. adds sedating herbs.

groups.products: Professional Sound Sleep, Ginkgo Leaf, Lion's Mane Mushroom, Passionflower Liquid Extract
groups.caution: Ginkgo has antiplatelet activity — stop two weeks before surgery, and take care with an anticoagulant or antiplatelet. Sound Sleep and passionflower are sedating and additive with alcohol and other sedatives.
